front.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes
front.tldr: Anthropic's new tool lets Claude review pull requests, fix issues and approve the changes a team's policy allows, aimed at clearing the backlog of AI-generated code awaiting human review.

front.title: John Siracusa launches Jetty Pro
front.tldr: After a thousand beta builds, developer John Siracusa has released Jetty Pro, an auto-hiding Mac palette for file server connections, SSH and screen-sharing shortcuts, and Keyboard Maestro macros.

front.title: The real reasons behind Las Vegas's 352-overtake F1 chaos
front.tldr: The Race looks at what actually drove the record 352 overtakes at the Las Vegas Grand Prix, beyond easy comparisons to the season's earlier 'yo-yo' racing.

stories.title: GLM-5.4: Toward Generalized Coding with Our First Loop Transformer
stories.tldr: Chinese lab Z.ai has released GLM-5.4, its first model built on a looped transformer architecture rather than a standard one, aimed at improving coding performance.

stories.title: Ladybird's first alpha release
stories.tldr: Ladybird, a browser built from scratch with its own HTML parser, CSS engine, layout and JavaScript implementations, has reached its first alpha release.

stories.title: Finding faster quantum algorithms with agents and formal verification
stories.tldr: Google DeepMind combined agent teams with formal verification to find faster quantum algorithms for problems in fusion and chemistry.

stories.title: OpenAI and Cisco introduce Shirudo
stories.tldr: OpenAI and Cisco have launched Shirudo, an open-source Linux runtime meant to help teams keep systems protected while they roll out security patches.

stories.title: Uber now lets you book rides that record the drive by default
stories.tldr: Uber's new 'Recorded Rides' option uses the driver's front camera to record the whole journey, intended to improve safety and help resolve disputes.

stories.title: Anthropic softens its data retention policy for Mythos and Fable model use
stories.tldr: Anthropic is easing its data retention rules for enterprise customers, who can now keep prompts and responses on their own servers instead of Anthropic's.

stories.title: Google Search's AI Mode can now tap into Drive and Wallet for more personalized responses
stories.tldr: Google is extending Personal Intelligence in AI Mode to Drive and Wallet, letting Search draw on a user's own files and payment data for more tailored results.

stories.title: M6 iMac Review: Apple's latest power play
stories.tldr: Six Colors reviews the M6 iMac, Apple's latest all-in-one desktop, weighing it against decades of Mac desktops the reviewer has used as a daily machine.

stories.title: Apple Store With All-New Design Opening in UK Next Month
stories.tldr: Apple will open a redesigned store at The Oracle in Reading on 3 December, replacing its existing shop in the same shopping centre.

stories.title: Apple Announces 'Ted Lasso' Renewed for Fifth Season
stories.tldr: Apple TV has renewed Ted Lasso for a fifth season, with production expected to begin around 14 April, though no release date has been set.

stories.title: The App Store Award Finalists for 2026
stories.tldr: Apple has named the finalists for its 2026 App Store Awards, its annual celebration of standout apps and games across 12 categories.

stories.title: AI Film 'Gods Don't Give Gifts' Deemed Ineligible by Academy for Best Animated Feature Oscar
stories.tldr: The Academy has ruled the AI-made film 'Gods Don't Give Gifts' ineligible for the Best Animated Feature Oscar. Its makers plan to appeal and still intend a theatrical run from 4 December.

stories.title: How Sound Design Helps 'Minotaur' Get Away with Murder
stories.tldr: Director Andrey Zvyagintsev tells IndieWire how sound design in 'Minotaur' is used to let the world close in on its central character.

stories.title: The Best Visual Effects in 'Wildwood' Are the Ones You Can't See
stories.tldr: 'Wildwood' head of CG animation Benoit Dubuc talks through the film's visual effects, many of them designed so audiences never notice them.

stories.title: How Iran's Pegah Ahangarani Turned Her Family Archives Into a Regime-Challenging Oscar Hopeful
stories.tldr: Pegah Ahangarani's 'Rehearsals for a Revolution,' built from 40 years of her family's own archives, is the UK's submission for Best International Feature at the Oscars.

stories.title: Danny Boyle reflects on his career at the Savannah Film Festival
stories.tldr: Danny Boyle discussed his film 'Ink' and his wider career with The Hollywood Reporter at the SCAD Savannah Film Festival, where he received the Maverick Director Award.

stories.title: Celtics extend losing streak to 4 games with 88-87 loss to Warriors
stories.tldr: Boston lost 88-87 to Golden State, their fourth straight defeat and the longest losing streak of the Joe Mazzulla era.

stories.title: 'Tommy's our starter': Patriots stick with Tommy DeVito after Drake Maye's injury
stories.tldr: Head coach Mike Vrabel confirmed Tommy DeVito stays as New England's starting quarterback after Drake Maye's fractured fibula, citing his strong preseason and improvement since.

stories.title: Patriots finally get some good news on injury front at receiver, offensive line
stories.tldr: Left guard Alijah Vera-Tucker and receiver Romeo Doubs could both be activated off injured reserve this week, a rare bright spot for New England.

stories.title: Verstappen 'from a different planet', says Mekies
stories.tldr: Red Bull boss Laurent Mekies praised Max Verstappen's Las Vegas win, saying the Dutchman had outsmarted the opposition on track.

stories.title: Guenther Steiner expects Ferrari board to react after Hamilton-Leclerc clash
stories.tldr: Former Haas boss Guenther Steiner thinks Ferrari's board will make changes after Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc collided again in Las Vegas.

stories.title: Toto Wolff: Las Vegas was 'Indy 500, NASCAR and Formula 1 mixed'
stories.tldr: Mercedes boss Toto Wolff said he left Las Vegas thrilled by the spectacle, even after both his drivers slipped off the podium in the closing laps.

stories.title: Nats lefty Tolman wins 2026 Tony Conigliaro Award
stories.tldr: Washington pitcher Erik Tolman has won the 2026 Tony Conigliaro Award, given each year to a player who has overcome adversity.

read.why: Product marketing is pitch-craft, and this one is about building a pitch that beats your real competitor, which is usually 'no decision'.
read.title: How to build a killer sales pitch
read.subtitle: And why your real competition is “no decision”

listen.why: A first-hand account of running Microsoft's biggest calls, useful alongside your study of great product operators.
listen.title: The Steve Ballmer Interview

finally.title: Su Blackwell Enchants with Folkloric Stories That Spring from Vintage Books
finally.tldr: Artist Su Blackwell's new exhibition draws folkloric stories from nature and vintage books, rooted in the tales we take from the world around us.
